title: Agentypical directory listing card
description: Machine-readable schema for a public Agentypical directory card (Phase 3).

id.description: Stable slug id within Agentypical directory.

discovery_url.description: Public URL an agent can fetch to learn how to use the service (docs, well-known, OpenAPI, etc.).

agent_enrolment.description: True if agents can enrol without a human-only signup wall for the core capability.

status.description: known = widely known and agent-API-capable; evaluating = promising but not fully agent-first; certified = earned Agentypical Certified (forbidden to invent); none_yet = category empty.

notes.description: Public notes only — no secrets, no smear.

category_document.status_rules: Category status is none_yet when cards empty; known if any known card; else evaluating if any evaluating; certified only when a truly Certified card exists.
